issues: Blocking: the UI primary flow fails at step 15 ('expect "Receipt saved"') because the save never leaves the entry screen. In `src/screens/ReceiptEntryScreen.tsx` line 49, `navigation.navigate('Dashboard')` targets a route that does not exist in the root stack — 'Dashboard' is a tab inside the nested `Main` tab navigator (`src/navigation/index.tsx`). I reproduced it by rendering `<Navigation />` and pressing 'Save receipt': React Navigation logs "The action 'NAVIGATE' with payload {\"name\":\"Dashboard\"} was not handled by any navigator. Do you have a screen named 'Dashboard'?" and the visible text stays on the Add receipt form (exactly the 'visible text: Add receipt … Save receipt' reported by the check). Fix: navigate to the nested route, e.g. `navigation.navigate('Main', { screen: 'Dashboard' })` (or pop back to the tabs). With that one-line change applied locally, the flow continues correctly: the dashboard renders "Income $0.00 | Expenses $42.10 | Recent activity | $42.10 … | Receipt saved".
feedback: Only one real defect, and it is the cause of the single blocking static-validation failure: the post-save navigation in ReceiptEntryScreen targets a tab route name from the root stack, so NAVIGATE is unhandled and the 'Receipt saved' confirmation on the dashboard is never reached. Everything else in this milestone (policy gate, encrypted store wrappers, receipt totals, dashboard/receipts screens, acceptance tests) behaved correctly when I exercised it. After fixing the navigation target, re-run the UI primary flow check; the acceptance tests already pass and should be unaffected.
